title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/rules/racial-maximums.yaml
description: The only source of racial characteristic maximums. Warband rules and campaign advances reference these entries by id (`campaign.limit.racial-maximum.*`) instead of inlining statlines. The characteristics are named in full English (`weapon_skill`), not by the profile keys.

status.description: Editorial status of the catalogue. Currently `published`.

applies_to.description: What the maximums apply to. Currently always the profile itself.

profile.description: Stable race key the maximums describe (`human`, `elf`, `orc`, …). Never a display name: every lookup resolves it by id.

groups.description: Race warband groups (`warband-group.*`) whose bands this race governs by default. A profile of a band that belongs to several race groups that resolve to different rows is not decided by the group and needs its own `profile_keys` entry: ambiguity is reported, never guessed.

profile_keys.description: Profiles of a single race (a Vampire inside an Undead band, an Ogre hired by Ostlanders, a Troll in an Orc mob) that this row governs instead of the band's race. Declared, so construction and advances resolve them by id and no identity depends on the printed name.

note.description: Editorial note when the maximums need one (exceptions, sources).

maximum_characteristics.description: Maximum of every characteristic, named in full.
